_readme: Complete tenant data for this test. Resolve the contract tools against it: listSignals = signals filtered by status and date; getSignal = one signal; searchSignals = semantically matching signals (include dismissed only when asked); searchOpportunities = semantically matching opportunities across all statuses; getCustomer = customers[id]; getDiscoveryContext = discovery_context (null means the tool is unavailable). Write tools are unavailable.

discovery_context.strategy_summary: Northstar Reports: reporting and spec management for product teams. 2026 focus: win regulated industries.
non_goals: No per-customer custom export formats; the API is the integration path.

signals.excerpt: Do you store version history of opportunity descriptions? Can you add a button to show the version history? For us to be
signals.verbatim:
Do you store version history of opportunity descriptions? Can you add a button to show the version history? For us to be able to continue using Northstar as part of our medical device quality management system, version history is absolutely necessary. It would be important to see who has written the change. Basic audit trail.
[Reply from our CSM in the thread]: Thanks, we'll have something for you in the coming week or two.

signals.verbatim: Our auditors asked who changed the spec and when. Right now we export to PDF every Friday just to have a paper trail. We need change author and timestamp on every edit, otherwise the notified body will not accept the system.

opportunities.title: Diff view between spec versions
opportunities.problem: Users cannot see what changed between two versions of a spec and re-read the whole document.

opportunities.title: Scheduled report delivery
opportunities.problem: Report owners re-send the same report by hand every week to the same audience.

opportunities.title: Custom export formats
opportunities.problem: Enterprise customers want exports in their own XML/JSON layouts for legacy systems.

decision.reasoning: Not pursuing custom formats; enterprise customers use the API integration instead. Validated with 3 accounts in Q2.

opportunities.problem: Customers could not get data into downstream systems without engineering help.
